_meta.description: Amazon Ads Sponsored Products per campaign per placement per day (Reporting v3 spCampaigns by campaignPlacement). Retired: v3 report collection stopped for every store on 2026-11-20; Ads data from 2026-09-01 is in v_ads_placement_daily (ad_product = 'Sponsored Products'), and this table is deleted on 2026-12-31.
_meta.retention_note: rows older than 400 days are pruned nightly (newest snapshot per store never pruned where applicable); query beyond the window returns a report_date_note
caveats: For any day from 2026-09-01 read v_ads_placement_daily with ad_product = 'Sponsored Products'; use this table only for days before 2026-09-01, until it is deleted on 2026-12-31. Split a range at 2026-09-01 and never add the two: the same Ads data is in both.

Columns there: placement_classification → placement ('Top of Search on-Amazon', 'Detail Page on-Amazon', 'Other on-Amazon' …), campaign_name from rpt_ads_campaigns. cost and spend → total_cost; impressions and clicks as named; sales_14d → sales, purchases_14d → purchases, units_sold_clicks_14d → units_sold_from_clicks — but this table's conversions are 14-day and Stream's base window is 7 days for a seller (attribution_window_days), so compare traffic and cost across the two, not conversions. top_of_search_impression_share, acos_clicks_14d and roas_clicks_14d have no Stream twin.
Its rows stop on 2026-11-20, when v3 collection ended for every store (its schedules read superseded_by_stream): its newest day is not the newest Ads data.

columns.note: UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.
Marketplace this ads row belongs to. Query ads data per (store, country_code) directly — no need to reverse-map profile_id.
